  have h_u : ∀ n, u n = u₀ + n - 1 := by

  -- The sum of first 98 terms is 137

    rw [Finset.sum_range_eq_sum_range_succ]
    simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    ring_nf
  -- Solve for u₀

    rw [h_sum, h_sum_k, h₁]
    ring_nf
  -- Now compute the sum of even terms
  have h_even_sum : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 49, u (2 * k.succ) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 49, u₀ + (2 * k.succ) - 1 := by

  -- Simplify the expression
